editionData.title: More than 1.5 million people welcome Pope Leo XIV in northern Peru; Ukraine critic injured in Moscow car bombing, Russia says
editionData.description: Global headlines: More than 1.5 million people welcome Pope Leo XIV in northern Peru (“The pope is Chiclayan!” chanted the crowd in his adopted home city. “Chiclayo is with you!”); Ukraine critic injured in Moscow car bombing, Russia says (Sergei Zavorotny, previously an aide to Ukrainian Prime Minister Mykola Azarov, became a pro-Kremlin commentator in Russia); and Before he was Pope Leo, he was their bishop. Now he’s back home. (In an emotional homecoming, residents of Chiclayo, the Peruvian city that shaped Pope Leo XIV, welcomed him with reverence for one of their own). Markets leaned higher, with 7 of 7 tracked indexes up; S&P 500 up 0.00% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Ggml v1.0.0 (Overview ggml 1.0.0 prunes the deprecated public API and the legacy DIAG_MASK ops, adds configurable YaRN truncation and FP8 support, and...); Nvidia allegedly engineered scarcity by funding AI startups to buy its GPUs (Following the departure of now-former NVIDIA CEO, Jensen Huang, a new report by The Wall Street Journal (via Wccftech) has emerged...); and FAA issues national ground stop – lifted 4.5 hours later (Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed the outage on an outdated air traffic control system in which the routers “got overloaded with...). Product Hunt features CaptureFlow (Open-source screen recorder with instant share links), Replay (Mac meeting recorder with no bot. Pay once, no subscription), and Gemini Robotics 2.5 (Gemini Robotics 2.5: Google’s most capable robot model).
